Pharmacy stock and refills: daily challenge, 2026-12-29

The shared System Designer challenge for 2026-12-29: Pharmacy stock and refills. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

A pharmacy chain with 4,000 stores tracks how many boxes of each medicine every store has, takes refill requests, and shows patients which nearby store has their medicine today. If the system says a store has a box that is gone, a patient makes a wasted trip.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
